item.title: Government Cracks Down on IndiGo: Flights Cut, CEO Summoned as Operational Crisis Peaks
item.description: India’s Civil Aviation Ministry summoned IndiGo’s CEO amid widespread flight disruptions. The government ordered route cuts, strict compliance, and rapid refunds as operational chaos impacted passengers nationwide. DGCA will review the crisis further on December 10.

item.title: Violent clash breaks out in Odisha’s Malakanagiri after headless body of woman found; Full story here
item.description: A headless woman’s body sparks deadly clashes in Odisha’s Malkangiri, leaving dozens of homes damaged and villages in fear. Police and ODRAF deployed as tribal tensions rise what triggered the violence, and has peace finally returned?

item.title: India Announces Power-Packed Squad for Sri Lanka T20 Series: New Faces Join Post-World Cup Triumph
item.description: India has announced a 15-member squad for the T20 series against Sri Lanka, featuring fresh young talents alongside senior stars. The series marks India’s first outing after winning the 2025 ODI World Cup.

item.title: Vicky Kaushal wishes Katrina Kaif on 4th anniversary, shares first pic after welcoming baby
item.description: Vicky Kaushal and Katrina Kaif celebrate their 4th wedding anniversary with a heartwarming first post-baby photo. Sleep-deprived smiles and tender moments hint at their new life as parents- get a glimpse of Bollywood’s cutest couple after welcoming their son.

item.title: UP harnessing potential of youth to become skilled manpower hub: CM Yogi
item.description: Uttar Pradesh is training its youth to become global professionals. From robotics to electric vehicles, the state’s new ITIs promise high-paying jobs at home and abroad. Could UP be India’s next manpower powerhouse?

item.title: Winter Breakouts: How cold air and smog are triggering more acne; Explained
item.description: Winter breakouts aren’t just seasonal- they’re fuelled by cold air and rising smog. Discover why your skin is flaring up, how pollution and dryness trigger acne, and the expert tips to keep your face clear this chilly season.

item.title: Cold wave to sweep Delhi, UP and 13 other states; Fresh snowfall in hill regions
item.description: According to the IMD, dense fog is likely in isolated areas of Assam and Manipur between December 9 and 13, and in eastern Uttar Pradesh and Odisha on December 9-10 during the morning hours.

item.title: Goa Nightclub Fire: Accused Ajay Gupta claims Luthra brothers are responsible
item.description: Goa Police have initiated efforts to bring back the absconding Luthra brothers. According to reports, the police have sought help from Interpol to bring back the two brothers who fled to Thailand. The police want to issue a Blue Corner Notice against these two accused to facilitate their extradition to India.

item.title: Varanasi police seize large cough syrup stockpile; Secret warehouse unearthed
item.description: The police seized the consignment from a warehouse located behind an e-rickshaw charging station belonging to Manoj Yadav, a resident of Godaulia, which is reportedly linked to Shubham Jaiswal.
